import numpy as np

im = np.array(Image.open('../first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im = np.array(Image.open('../first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B = im[...,0],im[...,1],im[...,2]
def cat(r,g,b):
    if r<45 and g<45 and b<45: return ' '      # background dark
    if b>r+12 and b>70: return '~'             # water/blue
    if r>110 and r-b>35 and r>=g: return 'J'   # juice orange
    if abs(r-g)<14 and abs(g-b)<14:
        return '#' if r>150 else ('+' if r>95 else '.')  # glass/neutral
    if r>g>b: return 'w'                        # wood/brown
    return '?'
sx,sy=2,3
for y in range(0,144,sy):
    line=\"\"
    for x in range(0,256,sx):
        block=im[y:y+sy,x:x+sx].reshape(-1,3).mean(0)
        line+=cat(*block)
    print(f\"{y:3d} |\"+line+\"|\")
print(\"    \"+\"\".join([str((x//10)%10) for x in range(0,256,sx)]))
print(\"    \"+\"\".join([str(x%10) for x in range(0,256,sx)]))
EOF
